بمناسبة الدخول المدرسي 2026/2027: On the occasion of the 2026/2027 school year
Ooredoo الجزائر والكشافة الإسلامية الجزا: Ooredoo Algeria and the Algerian Muslim Scouts launch a national solidarity convoy for the benefit of underprivileged children
قافلة وطنية تجوب عدة ولايات من الوطن لتو: A national convoy touring several provinces of the country to distribute school bags and supplies to children from underprivileged families.
قافلة تضامنية خاصة ستجوب ولايات جيجل وبج: A special solidarity convoy will tour the provinces of Jijel, Béjaïa, and Tizi Ouzou, affected by recent forest fires.
بمناسبة الدخول المدرسي 2026/2027، جدّدت: On the occasion of the 2026/2027 school year, Ooredoo renewed its civic commitment and, in partnership with the Algerian Muslim Scouts, reaffirmed its support for children from underprivileged families by launching a national solidarity operation.
تأتي هذه المبادرة مواصلةً لسلسلة الأعمال: This initiative continues a series of civic actions that Ooredoo and the Algerian Muslim Scouts have consistently carried out jointly, which this year focused on two complementary axes. The first axis consists of a national solidarity convoy touring various provinces of the country, aimed at delivering and distributing school bags and supplies to the beneficiary children, coinciding with the start of the school year.
وبالتوازي مع ذلك، خُصصت قافلة تضامنية خا: In parallel, a special solidarity convoy was dedicated to children in the provinces of Jijel, Béjaïa, and Tizi Ouzou, which were affected by recent forest fires that impacted these areas, placing them in difficult circumstances.
ومن خلال هذه المبادرة التضامنية، حرصت Oo: Through this solidarity initiative, Ooredoo and the Algerian Muslim Scouts sought to provide tangible support to the children concerned and contribute, each from their position, to alleviating the difficulties faced by their families, enabling them to resume their educational path under the best possible conditions.
وقد تميّز الإطلاق الرسمي لهذه العملية بت: The official launch of this operation was marked by a ceremony held at the International Scouting Center in Algiers, in the presence of the General Commander of the Algerian Muslim Scouts, Mr. Abderrahmane Hamzaoui, and the General Manager of Ooredoo, Mr. Rony Tomeh, where they gave the starting signal for the national solidarity convoy, alongside the special convoy directed to the fire-affected provinces.
وعلى هامش هذه المناسبة، تم تكريم التلامي: On the sidelines of this occasion, the top five students in the Intermediate Education Certificate and the top five students in the Baccalaureate Examination for the 2026 session, among those enrolled in the ranks of the Algerian Muslim Scouts, were honored. Representatives of Ooredoo and the Algerian Muslim Scouts presented them with rewards in appreciation of their efforts and excellence, and to encourage them to successfully continue their educational path.
وبهذه المناسبة، صرّح القائد العام للكشاف: On this occasion, the General Commander of the Algerian Muslim Scouts, Mr. Abderrahmane Hamzaoui, stated: "We are pleased to continue our partnership with Ooredoo through this new solidarity initiative, which this year has taken on a national dimension, reflecting our shared commitment towards underprivileged children and families. The start of the school year is an important milestone in the life of every child, and from this perspective, our mobilization aimed to accompany those most in need of support across various provinces of the country, with special attention given to families in the provinces of Jijel, Béjaïa, and Tizi Ouzou, who suffered significantly from the repercussions of the recent forest fires. Through this convoy, the Algerian Muslim Scouts reaffirm their civic mission and adherence to the values of solidarity, brotherhood, and mutual aid, which form an essential pillar of the Algerian scouting movement."
من جهته، صرّح المدير العام لـ Ooredoo، ا: For his part, the General Manager of Ooredoo, Mr. Rony Tomeh, stated: "Through this operation, Ooredoo reaffirms its commitment towards the children and families who were most in need of support. Our operation this year took on a national dimension, through a convoy that will tour various provinces of the country to support children on the occasion of the start of the school year. We have also dedicated a special solidarity convoy to children in the provinces of Jijel, Béjaïa, and Tizi Ouzou, which were affected by recent forest fires. Faced with such hardships, it was our responsibility to be present alongside the families and to offer them, through concrete initiatives, our support and solidarity. Our partnership with the Algerian Muslim Scouts has enabled us to unite our efforts and embody this solidarity within the framework of grassroots action, close to the children and beneficiary families."
وبعيداً عن مراسم الإطلاق التي نُظمت بالج: Beyond the launch ceremonies organized in Algiers, the national caravan will continue its journey across several wilayas of the country, in collaboration between Ooredoo representatives, its volunteers, and the Algerian Muslim Scouts, to ensure the distribution of school bags and supplies to beneficiary children.
وبالتوازي مع ذلك، تم تجسيد المحور الخاص: In parallel, the specific focus of this operation was implemented in the wilayas of Jijel, Béjaïa, and Tizi Ouzou, with the aim of reaching children and families affected by the aftermath of the recent fires, standing by their side, and providing support during this difficult phase.
كما أسهمت هذه العملية الجديدة في تعزيز ا: This new operation also contributed to strengthening the sustainable partnership between Ooredoo and the Algerian Muslim Scouts, which is based on shared values of solidarity, citizenship, and community service. This initiative comes, in particular, as an extension of the school bag and supply distribution operation jointly organized last year for the benefit of needy children.
ومن خلال هذه المبادرة ذات البعد الوطني،: Through this nationwide initiative, complemented by a special solidarity mechanism for the fire-affected wilayas, Ooredoo continues its commitment to children and needy families. This operation also embodies Ooredoo's determination to make solidarity a living and shared value through grassroots initiatives deployed to serve the community.
